title: Mittag-Leffler modules are exactly those where every map from a finite free module is dominated by a map to a finitely presented module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises Mittag-Leffler modules by the condition that every map from a finite free module is mutually dominating with some map to a finitely presented module (statement lines 21379-21387). The proof does not check the definition directly: one implication is immediate from the existing characterisation, and for the other it lifts a map from a finitely presented module to a finite free one, uses the hypothesis there, notes that the kernel inclusion lets the map factor through the finitely presented module, and compares kernels after tensoring in the displayed commutative square (proof lines 21389-21414). The factoring step that transfers domination from the free module to the finitely presented one is the content. H2.
